# What people see instead of the stack

> Working document. Candidate names by the lead, 24 Nov 2026, asked for by Ambi: "more codified, Juju names, tasteful, where it
> does not give it all away". Vendor names appear in one place only: the key sheet, behind a tap on a wallet, where a person
> must know which website the key comes from.

| On screen | What it does, in the line under it | Behind it (key sheet only) |
|---|---|---|
| Tongue | speaks the films | voice service |
| Pigment | paints thumbnails and hero pictures | picture service |
| Elder | thinks and writes the big films | deep writer |
| Griot | writes the daily films | fleet writer |
| Scribe | reads, checks and fixes every line | text checker |
| Watcher | looks at every picture before you do | picture checker |

Words that go: "Tehuti scripts", "Other scripts", "Text checks", "Picture checks", "Money: Empty", "Key: None saved", "plan $45 CAD".
A wallet says, in this order: its level (drawn), what is left in dollars (live from the service once a key is in), and how many
films that is ("about 14 films left"). With no key it says "Asleep" and one action: "Wake it". A wallet under three days of films
turns gold and says so. The plan is one sentence on the whole tank: "Enough for 30 days of films", never a price list.
Effort knob, per film: Quick, Crafted, Masterwork, each with its minutes and its cost.
